correctness.rationale: For fixed center c the maximal centrally symmetric subset is exactly K∩(2c-K). The square root of its area is concave by Minkowski interpolation and Brunn–Minkowski, so rotational orbit averaging makes the polygon center globally optimal. For odd n the edge-normal systems of P_n and -P_n interlace into a regular 2n-gon with the same inradius, and the exact area ratio simplifies to 1-tan^2(pi/(2n)). The classical central-kernel uniqueness theorem supports the uniqueness statement.
